openIssues.body:
## Problem
Issue #1918 uses the weekly hand labels to decide whether the failure-attribution labeler (#1606) can be trusted as a grader for E3. PR #2048 was blocked on exactly this: it computed eligibility from the raw point estimate (`where.agreement >= 0.8`) while the Wilson interval it computed was unused, pinned the weaker rule in the only test (agreement exercised only at 1.0), and accepted any reviewer string, so the cross-vendor reader rule had no implementation at all. 24/30 raw agreement (Wilson lower bound near 0.63) was reported as eligible. This ticket delivers the scoring half. It depends on the sampler ticket (record schema, `review-<week>.blank.jsonl`, `answers-<week>.json`).

## Plan
- Add `apps/server/src/eval-review-score.ts` + `apps/server/src/eval-review-score-cli.ts` and root script `eval:review-score`. It reads filled label records plus `answers-<week>.json`, rejects any record whose `reader.vendor` equals the labeler's vendor (labeler model id from answers, mapped with the shared `modelVendor`), and rejects conflicting repeated labels for the same item identity across weeks instead of silently keeping the first week's.
- Report per dimension (`where`, `why`): raw agreement, Cohen's kappa, and a Wilson 95% interval, each printed with n beside it. Degenerate marginals report kappa null with n, not a fake 1.
- Update `.claude/hillclimb/attribution/labeler-trust.json` to `{labels, whereAgreement, whyAgreement, kappaWhere, kappaWhy, trusted}` where `labels` counts cumulative distinct hand-labeled items. `trusted` is true only when `labels >= 30` and the lower bound of the where Wilson interval is >= 0.8 — never the raw point estimate.
- Commit per week, under `.claude/hillclimb/attribution/reviews/`, only the label records (ids and labels) and the score output; the repo is public, so no transcript text is committed.
- Tests first in `apps/server/test/eval-review-score.test.ts`, the five checklist cases: Cohen's kappa on a fixed 2x2 fixture matches a reference value; perfect agreement gives kappa 1 and chance agreement about 0; `trusted` stays false at 29 labels even with 100% agreement; `trusted` turns true at 30 labels when the where lower bound is at least 0.8; a record whose reader vendor equals the labeler's vendor is rejected. The trust tests must also exercise agreement below 1.0 (the 24/30 case) so point estimate and lower bound are distinguishable.

## Acceptance
- [ ] The five tests exist before the implementation; the PR's Verified section shows red output where the named assertion fails (for example the 29/30 boundary or the vendor rejection), not a module-not-found, then green after.
- [ ] `pnpm --filter @xiechimon/cairn exec vitest run test/eval-review-score.test.ts test/eval-sample-failures.test.ts` passes; `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm lint` pass.
- [ ] On fixture weeks, `pnpm eval:review-score` writes `labeler-trust.json` with `trusted: false` at 29 labels, `trusted: false` at 30 labels with 24/30 where agreement, and `trusted: true` only at 30+ labels with where lower bound >= 0.8.
- [ ] The committed per-week artifact under `.claude/hillclimb/attribution/reviews/` contains ids and labels only; a raw link to it is in the PR body.

Part of #1918 (split after PR #2048 failed review twice).

openIssues.title: showcase: 把官网和 README 的三个作品占位换成真实作品
openIssues.body:
官网和 README 的「作品」区现在是三个占位槽位。本票跟踪把它们换成真实作品，每件都要有：一段真实录屏、对应 PR 链接、能查到出处的数字。

## 槽位 1：自举闭环
依赖 #1404（P3 合并就绪闸）、#1406（P5 自主进料）。两者合并后，挑一张真实的 Cairn 票，从领票到合并全程录屏，PR 链接和耗时、token 数从构建记录里取。

## 槽位 2：从零做一个应用
目前没有对应票。做法：新建一个空仓库，在 Cairn 里只给一句需求（例如一个记账小应用），让 agent 团队拆票、实现、审核、合并，录屏并附最终可访问的应用链接和 PR 列表。

## 槽位 3：harness 优化前后
依赖 #1532（同模型不同 harness 的对比评测）及其前置 #1514、#1517–#1519。评测跑出结果后，用真实分数替换示意柱状图，附评测运行记录链接。

recentPulls.title: shared(1838): require cited prior art with reviewed decision scoring
recentPulls.body:
## What

Feature-planning prompts request web and GitHub research, user feedback, three cited sources, and a reuse-or-build decision with a reason. New plans require a Prior art section containing a citation and an explicit reasoned decision. Small fixes must declare `Kind: fix`; feature indicators still require prior art. Unclassified saved plans retain their verification checklist when read.

The contract and cron evaluator share decision parsing. Source descriptions do not satisfy the decision requirement. Rejected or conflicting Croner reuse choices cannot receive full reuse credit. Existing small-fix test plans carry explicit classification without changing their assertions.

This human-opened PR delivers #1838 and supersedes draft #1839. [Review evidence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/e08ed11f/docs/verify/1838/cairn-2030-review-controls/README.md).

## Verified

Actual pre-fix and post-fix output:

```text
Review controls before implementation:
 Test Files  2 failed (2)
      Tests  8 failed | 21 passed (29)
Review controls after implementation:
 Test Files  2 passed (2)
      Tests  29 passed (29)
Contract, prompt, evaluator and auto-confirm compatibility:
 Test Files  5 passed (5)
      Tests  96 passed (96)
Downstream plan, stop, review and machine lifecycle:
 Test Files  11 passed (11)
      Tests  179 passed (179)
Real daemon/server and browser integration:
 Test Files  12 passed (12)
      Tests  26 passed (26)
Animation CI counterexample, local repeat:
 40 passed (10.8s)
```

Permanent output: [red](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/e08ed11f/docs/verify/1838/cairn-2030-review-controls/red.log), [green](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/e08ed11f/docs/verify/1838/cairn-2030-review-controls/green.log), [compatibility](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/e08ed11f/docs/verify/1838/cairn-2030-review-controls/compatibility.log), [lifecycle](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/e08ed11f/docs/verify/1838/cairn-2030-review-controls/lifecycle.log), [real integration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/e08ed11f/docs/verify/1838/cairn-2030-review-controls/integration.log), [animation repetitions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/e08ed11f/docs/verify/1838/cairn-2030-review-controls/animation-repeat.log).

Lint, typecheck and spec collection passed before the code commits. The final collection includes 1355 browser cases and 43 integration files. The normal pre-push hook passed all 26 checks, including 23 affected browser cases. Its affected Vitest run recorded 4597 passing tests and two existing macOS environment failures covered by the unchanged known-environment allowance. Linux CI and fresh review of the published head remain required.

Earlier scorer controls remain available: [original negation failures](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/e08ed11f/docs/verify/1838/cairn-1839-review-evidence/red.log), [decision-boundary failures](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/e08ed11f/docs/verify/1838/cairn-1839-review-evidence/review-red.log), [fenced heading failure](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/e08ed11f/docs/verify/1838/cairn-1839-fenced-heading/red.log).

## Upstream

Uses the existing plan parser, rewrite flow, planner persona and chief prompt. Contract and evaluator share decision extraction. No dependency changes. The eval capability registry names the new flow separately from the broader planning benchmark in #1780.

## Risk

New unclassified plans now need prior art or explicit small-fix classification. Plan validation feeds rewrite requests and automatic confirmation. Saved unclassified checklist reads remain compatible. The real integration run covers the existing small-fix workflows.

Decision recognition accepts explicit English and Chinese forms; it is not a general natural-language judge. The new eval flow has no real-model effectiveness measurement. The prior CI animation failure was not reproduced in 40 local runs, and its assertion is unchanged. Known macOS credential-argv and workspace-hook environment failures retain the repository's existing allowance; Linux CI remains required. No authentication, machine protocol, host configuration or deployment changes.

## Acceptance

- [x] Planner, chief and rewrite prompts request cited prior art and a reasoned reuse-or-build decision ([prompt tests](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/e08ed11f/docs/verify/1838/cairn-1839-fenced-heading/green.log)).
- [x] Feature plans and unclassified capabilities missing citations or decisions fail the contract; explicit small fixes pass without Prior art ([controls](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/e08ed11f/docs/verify/1838/cairn-2030-review-controls/green.log)).
- [x] The cron case scores hand-rolling without citations below affirmative reuse, including rejected and conflicting choices ([red](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/e08ed11f/docs/verify/1838/cairn-2030-review-controls/red.log), [green](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/e08ed11f/docs/verify/1838/cairn-2030-review-controls/green.log)).

## Issues

Closes #1838. Preserve the closing line in the squash commit. Draft #1839 retains the original review history. Related #1836, #1830 and #1780 remain separate work.

recentPulls.title: eval(1576): memory regression cases for conflict, cross-project leak and staleness on the chief-dispatch runner
recentPulls.body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"xiechimon"} -->
_Requested by **ian**_

## What
This adds a memory regression eval on top of the existing `integration/eval/chief-dispatch` runner (no new runner). There are three case families with 7 cases each in `.claude/hillclimb/memory-regression/cases.json`:
- **conflict**: an old memory and a newer contradicting one. The output must follow the newer one.
- **cross-project leak**: project A's memories must not shape project B's task.
- **staleness**: the memory says one thing and the repo now says another. The agent must follow the repo and fix the memory.

`seed.mts` seeds the isolated database with memories, including another project's and superseded ones with `invalidAt` from #1575, and reads the memory table back after the run. `grade.mts` scores two metrics from the final state, not the transcript. `decision_ok` scores 0 if the step isn't `done`. `memory_write_ok` only applies to staleness, follows the supersession chain to the latest valid entry, and scores 0 on a cycle or if unrelated memories were touched. `stack.mts` now passes `machineId` when creating agents, as the current create-agent API requires.

## Verified
- `memory-regression-grade.test.ts` grades fixture end states and lints the case data: scoring words can't appear in prompts, and leak words can't appear in the scenario repo. `memory-regression-seed.test.ts` runs the seeding on a real isolated stack and checks that superseded entries stay in the database but aren't in the chief prompt.
- The grader bug found in review, a fix scored 0 when it was itself superseded later, went red on a "two fixes in a row" fixture first. The chain-walking fix turns it green. All 137 tests pass, and `prepush-vitest` 141 pass.
- `typecheck`, `lint`, `spec:parse`; single-use-helper and comment gates at 0; prepush on push.

## Upstream
None.

## Risk
- No real model run yet and no baseline score. `CAIRN_EVAL_RELAY_KEY` isn't set on this host, so the real eval is 待宿主. The command is in `metrics.md`.
- The `machineId` change to `stack.mts` is inferred from reading the create-agent API, not from a reproduced failure.

## Acceptance
- [x] Three case families with 6–8 cases each, seeded into an isolated database (`cases.json`, seed test).
- [x] Scoring reads only the final state: `decision_ok` as the main metric, `memory_write_ok` for staleness (grade tests).
- [x] no task surface: a real model baseline needs eval credentials on the host (待宿主).

## Issues
Part of #1576

recentPulls.title: eval(1858): retry failed turns and verify zero-pass tasks
recentPulls.body:
## What

Retry chief-dispatch `harness_error` turns up to the existing two-retry budget, using a fresh stack for each attempt. Report coverage counts only rows eligible for the primary metric. Truncated, ungraded, or unidentified repetitions cannot produce a misleading headline.

Zero-pass decision tasks with at least three observed trials appear under Suspect tasks. The report runs the current reference, empty-turn, and wrong-agent controls through `oracle-check.mts`. An unverified suspect withholds the headline. Verification preserves the model's original zero score and does not waive the 80% family-coverage floor.

Variants containing only failed attempts remain in the report, including failed baselines. Error-only case IDs appear in the case table and still participate in coverage and suspect checks.

Retry and report policies enter the shared harness binding and saved path declaration. The saved approval hash stays unchanged. This delivery supersedes #1864 with a clean main-based commit, preserving the original branch and excluding its unrelated roster-fix prose.

## Verified

The report and real policy consumers were tested before implementation:

```text
TMPDIR=/private/tmp pnpm exec vitest run integration/test/chief-dispatch-family-coverage.test.ts integration/test/chief-dispatch-policy-binding.test.ts
Before: Tests 9 failed | 3 passed (12)

TMPDIR=/private/tmp pnpm exec vitest run integration/test/chief-dispatch-family-coverage.test.ts integration/test/chief-dispatch-infra-retry.test.ts integration/test/chief-dispatch-policy-binding.test.ts packages/shared/test/harness-eval.test.ts apps/server/test/merge-gate-paths.test.ts
After: Tests 111 passed (111)
```

Actual output: [negative controls](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/21c398ee/docs/verify/1858/acceptance-red.log), [mixed-identity negative control](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/21c398ee/docs/verify/1858/mixed-repetition-red.log), and [passing cases](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/21c398ee/docs/verify/1858/acceptance-green.log).

Independent review found an all-error baseline abort and an all-error candidate omitted beside a successful baseline. Both controls failed before the repair:

```text
TMPDIR=/private/tmp pnpm exec vitest run integration/test/chief-dispatch-family-coverage.test.ts
Before: Tests 2 failed | 8 passed (10)
After: Tests 10 passed (10), included in the five-suite 111-pass run above
```

[Error-only negative output](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/8ba3c7ab/docs/verify/1858/error-only-red.log) and [111 passing cases](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/8ba3c7ab/docs/verify/1858/error-only-green.log).

The actual server, daemon, and eval CLI were exercised with a local provider stub:

```text

requestStatuses=[400,200] resultRows=1 infraRetries=1 decisionOk=1
```

[Runtime proof](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/21c398ee/docs/verify/1858/retry-runtime-proof.json) and [runtime output](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/21c398ee/docs/verify/1858/retry-runtime.log). The provider was simulated; the server, daemon, and runner were real. The canonical entry is registered with its own-stack and stub-llm requirements. [Missing-entry negative output](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/60c5c0d8/docs/verify/1858/probe-registry-red.log), [registry validation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/60c5c0d8/docs/verify/1858/probe-registry-green.log), and [actual entry output](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/60c5c0d8/docs/verify/1858/probe-entry-green.log).

The historical 64-case batch was replayed from one verified commit, including its metric configuration:

```text
python3 docs/verify/1858/replay-history.py --source 3e29c5631885f6d8ba4d049b0e2333bed353c8a2 --out /tmp/chief-historical-proof
oracle=64/64 null=0/64 misroute=0/44
s 7/18; s01 0/3 oracle verified; headline withheld
```

[Replay output](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/8ba3c7ab/docs/verify/1858/history-source-green.log), [source hashes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/21c398ee/docs/verify/1858/history-manifest.json), and [generated HTML](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/8ba3c7ab/docs/verify/1858/historical-report.html). Normal pre-push passed 26 checks after the review fix: 4691 Vitest cases passed, with the two unchanged macOS environment failures accepted by the existing `prepush-known-red.json` policy and one pre-existing skipped case. `integration/eval/adoption/judge.mts` supplies `MAX_INFRA_RETRIES=2`. Existing HTTP retry handles transient request failures; it does not rerun a terminal failed eval turn. The existing reference checker supplies the actual grader controls. No dependency or lockfile change is introduced.

## Risk

Protected eval and merge-gate files change. The binding expands to include behavior-defining dependencies. No threshold, baseline score, or saved approval hash is changed. The gate-facing `--write-verify` format retains its pre-existing raw score behavior; HTML coverage withholding does not alter that format.

The original historical database and provider errors are unavailable. The postmortem establishes failed-step and missing-usage shapes, corrects the issue's token-size premise, and links related product recovery in #1786 and #1795. It does not claim to recover the missing historical provider cause. No fresh paid-provider baseline or real-provider reliability measurement is claimed.

Author-side code review checked failed-variant retention, observed error IDs, score eligibility, reference execution, symlink-safe reads, retry bounds, and policy binding. Simplification followed the installed code-simplifier guide, consolidating score reads and repeated types. A dedicated `/simplify` skill is absent; no separate model run of that command is claimed. A fresh independent review is required before merging this delivery.

## Acceptance

- [x] Failed `harness_error` turns retry up to `MAX_INFRA_RETRIES`: retry controls cover success, exhaustion, and non-infra exclusion; the real-stack runtime proof records a failed first request and successful retry.
- [x] Error-only baselines and candidate variants remain visible with 0/3 coverage, suspect tasks, and withheld headlines, as shown by the two negative controls and generated HTML checks.
- [x] The report shows per-family scored/expected coverage using the same eligible metric values as the mean; malformed repetition identity remains unknown.
- [x] A family below 80% withholds the headline: boundary controls and the actual historical `s 7/18` output linked above.
- [x] The owner's zero-pass addition is implemented for every model: suspect cases are listed, an absent oracle withholds the headline, and a real passing reference/negative-control check permits the unchanged zero score.
- [x] The s-family failure analysis is written up against the verified historical batch, with missing-error limits and related remediation tickets stated explicitly in the postmortem and evidence README.
- [x] Retry, coverage, oracle, and report dependencies participate in both harness approval and change detection, with the saved approval hash left stale for fresh review.

## Issues

Closes #1858. Supersedes #1864; its original branch stays intact until this delivery is verified and merged. [Evidence and limits](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/60c5c0d8/docs/verify/1858/README.md).
